versions.subject: add lnx_system_network_connections_discovery.yml, oscd initiative issue #1011, task number 8
Renamed ProcessName field to Image for the process_creation category.
filter some legitimate activity
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith:
        - '/who'
        - '/w'
        - '/last'
        - '/lsof'
        - '/netstat'
legit_landscape_sysinfo:
    ParentCommandLine|contains|all:  # "/usr/bin/python /usr/bin/landscape-sysinfo "
        - '/usr/bin/python'
        - '/usr/bin/landscape-sysinfo' 
condition: selection and not legit_landscape_sysinfo
